docs.purpose: The MaxBLD Help & Support page on maxbld.ca: what support covers. The mail link to the one admin-set support inbox lands with that setting (Spec 126 §11b.7 dated note 2026-11-11 item 3); until then no address is shown.
docs.data_story: This surface reaches **no API contract at all**: every word is a content key of its own content file, laid out by its page in the static page table.
docs.under_126: **CONVERTED** (MF-46 stage C): descriptor + content + the one web STATIC binding (Spec 126 §11b.1). It owns no component.

contracts: none — the mount imports only the binding and src/lib/surfaces/maxbld-static.ts

identity.owner: Admin domain (Spec 126 §14 Target Files) — the conversion programme owns the row; no individual owner is named by Specs 126/127/128.
spec_refs: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §11b.7 W9 and dated note 2026-11-11 item 3 — Help & Support

versioning.why: Nothing consumes it: a leaf page from content.

inputs.why: It reads no contract: the page and its strings are committed files.

state.why: No store and no local state.

staleness.why: Its content changes only when its content file is redeployed.

session.why: Public on maxbld.ca: the public row /help → /parcel-tool/help; the page gates nothing (it never calls requireParcelToolPage).
evidence: src/tests/host-policy.logic.test.ts — the plain pages are served signed out

checks.why: Spec 128 R-18: guards.session anon equals the host table's class for the page (the public row /help → /parcel-tool/help, public); the page calls no contract. Checked by src/tests/surfaces/auth-class-parity.infra.test.ts.

The footer (Terms, Privacy, Help & Support and the short legal line, ruling L-R3) is the same on every MaxBLD plain page and the legal line equals the search page's search.legal; pinned by src/tests/surfaces/static-page.logic.test.ts.

errors.why: No fetch: a render error is caught by the plain pages' error boundary (web_maxbld_error).

emits.why: It calls no captureEvent and writes no ledger row.

metering.why: No usage_events write and no quota.

notes: MF-46 stage C (plan ~/Buildo-scratch/mcfrontend/MF-46/plan.md v3 §12 folds 16, 18, 22; operator round 2026-11-11 "1 y 2 y 3 ? 4y 5 y 6 y 7 y ... 8. y").

programme.why: The MaxBLD web front door (Spec 126 §11b.7 W9; business requirement 5): a plain page of maxbld.ca.
